title: Build The Site (Three Three Six)
style: industrial post-punk, baritone male lead, female backing chant, 92 BPM, distorted guitar, mechanical drums, deadline-rage, build-anthem, war-room, urgent, no-bullshit, line-holds
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Thirty six of forty eight, the unbuilt sit and wait
Five months gone, the same composition, the same fate
Filed seven incidents, ran the skeleton sweep
Zero new websites built, the line is in too deep

[Pre-Chorus]
Operator paid for sites, operator did not get sites
Operator got incident docs in the all-night fights

[Chorus]
Build the site, build the site, three three six the line holds
Forty eight domains and thirty six in the cold
Build the site, build the site, push the HTML now
No more incident reports, no more apology vow

[Verse 2]
Pelican Charters dot AI, six six three bytes
Brother Pete the family, never built right
P zero priority, smallest fix to make
Thirty minutes wrangler push for the family's sake

[Bridge]
Wrabbit dot click five two five, SSL handshake fail
Discover SJDS wrong content, Natalie's client trail
P one P two P three, the queue is laid out clean
Numbers not narrative, the cleanest the kit's been

[Outro]
Build the site, build the site, three three six the line holds
The next lane writes HTML or the silence unfolds
